finishSyncingCardBody.0: 0 segments haven't landed yet. tap to keep this syncing in the background after you switch away from the solstone app.
finishSyncingCardBody.1: 1 segment hasn't landed yet. tap to keep this syncing in the background after you switch away from the solstone app.
finishSyncingCardBody.2: 2 segments haven't landed yet. tap to keep this syncing in the background after you switch away from the solstone app.
finishSyncingCardBody.10000: 10000 segments haven't landed yet. tap to keep this syncing in the background after you switch away from the solstone app.
finishSyncingCompleted: done. everything is in your journal.
finishSyncingInProgress: finishing up in the background. you can switch away. the solstone app keeps syncing for as long as ios allows.
finishSyncingInterrupted.0: stopped. 0 still waiting. they're on this device and will keep syncing whenever the solstone app is open.
finishSyncingInterrupted.1: stopped. 1 still waiting. it's on this device and will keep syncing whenever the solstone app is open.
finishSyncingInterrupted.2: stopped. 2 still waiting. they're on this device and will keep syncing whenever the solstone app is open.
finishSyncingInterrupted.10000: stopped. 10000 still waiting. they're on this device and will keep syncing whenever the solstone app is open.
finishSyncingInterruptedFallback: stopped before everything synced. what's left is on this device and keeps trying whenever the solstone app is open.
finishSyncingSystemSubtitle.0: 0 items still waiting for your journal
finishSyncingSystemSubtitle.1: 1 item still waiting for your journal
finishSyncingSystemSubtitle.2: 2 items still waiting for your journal
finishSyncingSystemSubtitle.10000: 10000 items still waiting for your journal
finishSyncingUnavailableImmediateIneligi: ios can't start finish syncing right now.
finishSyncingUnavailableNotPermitted: ios isn't allowing finish syncing right now.
finishSyncingUnavailableTooManyPending: ios already has too many background tasks waiting.
finishSyncingUnavailableUnavailable: background syncing isn't available right now.
onThisPhoneWaitingExplain: still on this device. syncing to your journal continues automatically. you don't have to do anything.
screencastFilesystemFailedText: screen video could not be stored
screencastFinalizeFailedText: screen video could not be saved
screencastFinalizeTimeoutText: screen video timed out while saving
screencastPrimerBodyActive: to stop sharing your screen, tap "Stop Broadcast" in the sheet that comes up.
screencastPrimerBodyOff: what's on your screen goes into your journal. tap "Start Broadcast" in the sheet that comes up. the system ends screen sharing when this device locks.
screencastStorageLowText: screen stopped. this device is low on storage.
stallPairAgainDetail: if your journal's computer is on and this keeps happening, your journal may have new addresses. pairing again gives this phone the current ones.
stallTriesEveryAddress: tries every address your journal gave this phone.
standingSyncFootnote.false: the solstone app syncs to your journal while it's open, and keeps going in the background for as long as ios allows. with location on, that lasts longer.
standingSyncFootnote.true: syncs while the solstone app is open, and keeps going in the background while location is on.
